description: This is a Java source file defining the ContractService class, which provides services related to Contract entities such as printing, approval workflow, retrieval, and persistence within a Spring application.

classes.name: ContractService
classes.description: This class provides methods for handling Contract-related operations, including printing contracts as PDFs, supervising approval flow, acceptance validation, retrieval from database, and saving.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Uses PdfService to print a given Contract as a PDF.

methods.name: sendToSupervisor
methods.description: Seeks the first supervisor who can accept the contract based on contract value, and assigns the supervisor to the contract if found.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Accepts the contract if the currently authenticated user is authorized to do so.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Contract with a specific ID from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the given Contract to the database.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Returns the list of Contracts associated with a specific Client.

methods.name: findByAcceptedBy
methods.description: Returns the list of Contracts accepted by a specific User.
